ctaHeading: Ascot Vale's carpenters are ready — let's build your dream space.
aboutText: With over 15 years of hands-on experience, Instruct Build specialises in creating custom decks, pergolas, and outdoor living spaces across Melbourne. Based in Ascot Vale, we work closely with homeowners to design and build solutions that suit your space, lifestyle, and budget. Our commitment to quality and attention to detail ensures that every project is built to last, adding comfort and value to your home.
servicesText: At Instruct Build, we provide comprehensive carpentry services tailored to Melbourne homes. From designing and building Merbau decks to constructing pergolas and upgrading interiors, our expertise ensures practical solutions and lasting value for your property.

services.title: Custom Decking
services.desc: Design and build durable Merbau and composite decks tailored to your outdoor space and lifestyle.

services.title: Pergola Construction
services.desc: Construct custom pergolas using quality timber to create functional and attractive outdoor structures for shade and style.

services.title: Home Renovations
services.desc: Upgrade your interiors with expert carpentry, from kitchen fit-outs to custom shelving, ensuring high-quality finishes.

services.title: Outdoor Living Spaces
services.desc: Transform your backyard into a comfortable retreat with decks, pergolas, and landscaping features designed for relaxation.

services.title: Timber Repairs
services.desc: Fix and restore damaged timber structures like decks and pergolas to prolong their life and maintain appearance.

services.title: Composite Decking
services.desc: Install low-maintenance composite decking that offers durability, modern aesthetics, and long-lasting performance.
